column1: # Source 1: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity curations (clingen_gene_validity.csv), downloaded from
# Version: 2026-08-27 (ClinGen's own 'FILE CREATED:' date; ClinGen is a living curation, not a tagged release)
# Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain); ClinGen requests attribution and the date accessed.
# Source 2: EBI Gene2Phenotype (G2P) developmental-disorder panel export (DDG2P.csv), downloaded from
# Version: 2026-08-28 (accessed-on date; this G2P export does not embed a dataset release/version string of its own)
# Licence: EBI Gene2Phenotype terms -- freely available for use, with attribution requested. See https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gene2phenotype/about/project
# 2869 associations across 2561 genes. confidence values seen: definitive=1482; disputed=4; limited=357; moderate=272; refuted=2; strong=752.

# hgnc_id is DDG2P's own 'hgnc id' column, prefixed 'HGNC:'; mutation_consequence is DDG2P's 'variant consequence'; inheritance is DDG2P's own 'allelic requirement' vocabulary (biallelic_autosomal, monoallelic_autosomal, monoallelic_X_hemizygous, monoallelic_X_heterozygous, monoallelic_X, monoallelic_Y_hemizygous, mitochondrial) -- a DIFFERENT code space from ClinGen's MOI column above; the two are never merged into one vocabulary, only stacked as separate rows distinguished by `source`. classification_date is DDG2P's 'date of last review'; gcep is always empty for DDG2P rows (ClinGen-specific concept); panel is DDG2P's own semicolon-joined sub-panel membership (e.g. 'DD; Eye'), always empty for ClinGen rows.

# disease_id prefers DDG2P's 'disease MONDO' column, falls back to 'disease mim' (prefixed 'OMIM:') when MONDO is blank, and is left EMPTY when both are blank (123 of 2869 rows) -- never a fabricated identifier.

# Gene-symbol cross-check against knowledge/real/gene_panel.tsv (gnomAD): 206 of 2561 DDG2P gene symbols were not found there (171 carry an X-linked/Y-linked allelic requirement and are explained by gene_panel.tsv's chrX/Y coverage gap); remaining sample: AFG2A, AFG2B, BLTP1, CBS, CPAP, CRYAA, DNAAF19, DRC2, DRC4, GBA1, GMNN, H3-3A, HYCC1, LYSET, MIR140, MIR17HG, MIR184, MT-TL1, MT-TP, MYL11, ... (15 more).

# Every classification from BOTH sources is kept VERBATIM in confidence, including ClinGen's Disputed, Refuted and 'No Known Disease Relationship' and DDG2P's (lower-case) disputed/refuted: curated-and-refuted is real evidence, and dropping it would make absence indistinguishable from refutation (GP-14, generalised). ClinGen values seen in this download: Definitive=2291; Disputed=197; Limited=545; Moderate=455; No Known Disease Relationship=48; Refuted=49; Strong=83.

# inheritance carries ClinGen's own MOI code unmodified for ClinGen rows (AD=autosomal dominant; AR=autosomal recessive; XL=X-linked; SD=semidominant; MT=mitochondrial; UD=undetermined); mutation_consequence is always empty for ClinGen rows -- ClinGen's curation model does not capture this concept.
# Gene-symbol cross-check against knowledge/real/gene_panel.tsv (gnomAD): 265 of 3029 ClinGen gene symbols were not found there.
#   192 of those carry an X-linked (XL) MOI record and are explained by gene_panel.tsv's documented chrX/Y coverage gap, not a symbol mismatch.

#   The remaining 73 are mostly mitochondrial genes (gnomAD's nuclear constraint model does not cover mtDNA) and a handful of recent HGNC renames / non-protein-coding loci: AFG2A, AFG2B, BLTP1, CBS, CLXN, COXFA4, CRIPTO, CSF2RA, DNAAF19, DRC2, DRC4, GBA1, GMNN, H3-3A, HYCC1, ICOSLG, IGHM, IGKC, KCNE5, MIR140, ... (53 more).
